Disinfection is achieved by adding sodium hypochlorite (12.5%) to the treated wastewater in the chlorine contact basin.
The WWTF is also equipped with a 200,000-gallon emergency storage tank.

The required volume to achieve a 90 minute modal time is provided by the effluent force main, which is approximately 1,680 linear feet of 6-inch diameter pipe and an existing 21,000 gallon effluent storage tank near the percolation ponds.

The discharge infrastructure of the WWTF will be modified so that treated effluent can be discharged directly to the sprayfield when recycled water is needed and to preclude discharge of treated effluent from the evaporation/percolation ponds to the sprayfield.
